title: M3-PG sticky band
description: One full-width media band (2.12:1, a graphic pattern or panorama) between 10/20px gutters that sticks just under the header while the next section, on its own white ground, slides up over it like a sheet of paper.
notes: it sticks within its parent: wrap it with the sections that follow (as page.tsx does) so it stays pinned while they pass
the next sections need a background and to sit above it (relative z-10 bg-background); m3-pg-projects and m3-pg-statement do
